en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 6, 2026
en.summary: The EU’s updated Disability Rights Strategy draws criticism for lacking ambition and new legislation; model‑activist Tasha Ghouri launches an accessible fashion brand and online store; a city council approves a study to assess ADA compliance at City Hall; a university adopts a new digital accessibility policy; and a study reveals a major shortage of accessible housing in Toledo.

highlights.title: Update of EU Disability Rights Strategy lacks ambition to advance our rights
Tasha Ghouri launches 'accessible' fashion brand and webstore
City Council Approves Study on ADA Accessibility at City Hall
University adopts policy on digital accessibility
Toledo faces major gap in accessible housing, study finds

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日消息 – 2026年5月6日
zh-TW.summary: 歐盟殘疾人權利戰略更新被批評缺乏野心和新立法措施；模特兼活動人士塔莎·古里推出無障礙時尚品牌及線上商店；市議會批准評估市政廳ADA無障礙合規的研究；大學採納數位無障礙政策；研究顯示托萊多存在嚴重的無障礙住房缺口。

highlights.title: 歐盟殘疾人權利戰略更新缺乏野心，未能推進權利
塔莎·古里推出『無障礙』時尚品牌及網店
